content: The main goal of NCEL is to find a solution for collective entity linking using an end-to-end neural model, rather than to improve the measurements of local textual similarity or global mention/entity relatedness. Therefore, we use joint embeddings of words and entities at sense level BIBREF28 to represent mentions and its contexts for feature extraction. In this section, we give a brief description of our embeddings followed by our features used in the neural model.
